newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Second part of Russia Svyazinvest sale not seen 97.
newsitem.headline: Second part of Russia Svyazinvest sale not seen 97.

text.p: Russia will probably not sell a 24 percent stake in Russian telecoms company Svyazinvest this year, though plans to auction another stake of 25 percent plus one share are practically ready, the privatisation minister said on Thursday.
"The 24 percent of Svyazinvest earmarked for Russian investors in all probability will not be sold this year," Alfred Kokh told a news conference.

Russia plans to sell 49 percent of the holding company. Kokh said earlier in the day that the auction for 25 percent plus one share, which allows the holder to block charter changes, might be officially announced next Tuesday.
OAO Svyazinvest has controlling stakes in most regional Russian telecoms and is set to acquire a government stake in long distance carrier Rostelekom.
